learning_outcomes.text: Able to perform experimental tests to determine physical and mechanical properties of materials.
Able to perform non-destructive tests to identify defects in materials.
Able to perform experimental tests related to the protection of materials against corrosion.
Able to perform experimental welding tests with specimens and check for defects and their mechanical properties.

syllabus_topics: Characterization and selection of different materials
Determination of physical and mechanical properties (tensile, compression, hardness, fatigue, torsion, impact)
Non-destructive testing (sound, magnetic particles, liquid penetrants)
Metallography
Degradation-corrosion (climatic chamber and salt spray)
Protection (application of coatings)
Defects in material joints (welding, adhesives)
Relationship of results obtained in tests
Seminar 1: Mechanical behavior of composite materials
Seminar 2: Joints in composite materials
Seminar 3: Structural Health Monitoring
Laboratory Practice 1: Corrosion protection. Application of paints.
Laboratory Practice 2: Corrosion protection. Protection evaluation.
Laboratory Practice 3: Non-destructive testing. Liquid penetrants.
Laboratory Practice 4: Non-destructive testing. Magnetic particles.
Laboratory Practice 5: Fabrication of laminates and sandwiches.
Laboratory Practice 6: Testing of composite materials.
Laboratory Practice 7: Identification of polymers.
Laboratory Practice 8: Concrete dosage.
Laboratory Practice 9: Welding.
Laboratory Practice 10: Welding.
teaching_methods: Independent study (including report writing and practice completion)

assessment_methods.method: Controls on seminars and/or practical contents
Practices (Reports and presentations of practical work)

assessment_rules: The continuous assessment grade is divided into three parts. The minimum grade in each part to apply continuous assessment is 3 points. Students who do not pass by continuous assessment will have to take an exam in the ordinary and extraordinary calls. Parts are kept for the ordinary call, but continuous assessment is not kept for the extraordinary call.
